t: What kinship asked for after creation was finished
a: قَالَتِ الرَّحِمُ هَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ الْقَطِيعَةِ. قَالَ نَعَمْ أَمَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ. وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ
p: Qālati-r-raḥim: hādhā maqāmu-l-ʿāʾidhi bika mina-l-qaṭīʿah. Qāla: naʿam, amā tarḍayna an aṣila man waṣalaki wa aqṭaʿa man qaṭaʿaki
m: Kinship said: this is the place of one seeking refuge in You from being severed. He said: yes. Would you not be content that I keep connection with whoever keeps connection with you, and cut off whoever cuts you off?
